scripts.db:migrate: npx wrangler d1 migrations apply chinapoll-local --local --persist-to .wrangler && npm run admin -- initialize-settings
scripts.dev: npm run db:migrate && npm run build && (vite preview --host 0.0.0.0 --port 5173 & npx wrangler dev dist/worker/index.js --no-bundle --local --persist-to .wrangler --port 8787 --live-reload=false & wait)
scripts.dev:worker: npm run db:migrate && npm run build:worker && npx wrangler dev dist/worker/index.js --no-bundle --local --persist-to .wrangler --port 8787 --live-reload=false
scripts.build: tsc -b && vite build && npm run build:worker
